description: A JavaScript module providing an API client for a food ordering system, including functions for health check, fetching menu items, creating orders, and checking order status with fallbacks to static data and local storage.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches menu items from backend or returns static menu on failure.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order, either via backend or simulates it locally.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Fetches order status from backend or local storage fallback.
